Item.Description: Company code must match the Declarant/nominated agent or company must exist in the companyPort table where defaultPort is Y if processing a import message
UVI part of the UCN must be a valid voyage. Check the MUCR.
Chars 6-8 must be a valid port

1: Chars 8-16 must be numeric. 2: If RFF/UCN segment is present, UCN must be in a valid format i.e. numeric for non-entry manifesting and in the format 99999xxxyyyyyyyyyyyy for entry manifesting (check the MUCR). 3: The last 16 chars of UCN must be spaces (check the MUCR).
Port of import must match the CHIEFCode on the workingPort for the import voyage
Must not be part of an amalgamation
UCN must be entered if EDI transaction code is CCR or AMC. Check the MUCR.
Manifest must be complete or frozen

1: If EDI Transaction code has a mode of 'C' then the consignment must not be cleared. 2: If EDI transaction Code has a mode of 'A' then use the entryNo from the CUSDEC and the EPU from workingPort table to find the UCN. If the UCN has been changed, the UCN (CUSDEC) must not have an entry. 3: Customs entry date must not be set if EDI transaction code has a mode of 'C'
Device must have a delivery method of 'EDI'
1: Must not be set for delete or set to purge. 2: Must not have been set for purge. 3: Manifest must not be set for delete
UCN must be at the lowest level
If entered, user must be authorised for the company
If UVI references a non-arrived voyage then arrival Ind must be 'N'. Check the MUCR and entry substyle.
Must not have an entry in progress
If EDI transaction mode is 'C' and UVI references an arrived voyage then arrival Ind must be 'Y'. Check the MUCR and entry substyle.
1: Packages must match the number manifested for the entered consignment. 2: Packages must not be zero. Check box 6.
Must not already have a declaration (UCR/ETC or clearance list)
Chars 9 must not be blank
Chars 9-20 must not match a containerID on the importUnit table for the specified Flight, if EDI transaction code has mode of ‘C’
Chars 21-25 must be blank
Entered company or if not entered one of the users companies must be authorised for the supplied device.
Port of import must exist as a CHIEFCode on a workingPort
Company must have access to the workingPort found above. (must be row in companyPort for companycode/workingPort)
If UVI references a depot and the UCN has not arrived then arrival ind must be 'N'. Check the MUCR and entry substyle.
CSD must not be 'E '
If EDI transaction mode is 'C' and the UVI references a depot and the UCN has arrived then arrival ind must be 'Y'. Check the MUCR and entry substyle.
CSD must not be 'C ', '0 ' or 'EX'
Must not have a transhipment port unless the UCN entered references a 12 digit devanned consignment
Voyage must not have departed unless the load complete has not been done
1: If ingated then the arrival ind must be 'Y'. 2: If not ingated then the arrival ind must be 'N'.

1: If EDI transaction Code has a mode of 'A' then use the entryNo from the CUSDEC and the EPU from workingPort table to find the UCN. (It may not be the same UCN as on the CUSDEC). The UCN (CUSDEC and old) must not have a clearance. 2: If EDI transaction code has mode of ‘A’ the original UCN (for the reference) must not be cleared.
UCN must be blank. Check the MUCR.
EDI transaction code must exist in the EDItransaction table
Company must have a valid EDI badge code for the mode of operation
1: EDI service must be available (State from the CHIEFConfig table for channel 'EDI' must be 1 or 2). 2: Number of open EDI sessions must be less than EDIMax

This is usually caused by problems in connectivity or session establishment between CHIEF and the CSP. The link between the CSP and CHIEF may be down, or your badge may be incorrectly configured. Please contact the CSP helpdesk.
First 5 chars of UCN must reference a valid flight
